note: The floor under each check's examined count, recorded on the date above from a full run. A floor rather than an equality: counts differ between platforms and grow with the corpus, and a baseline that went red on a file being added would be suppressed and then dead. At or above passes. Below fails, names the check and prints both figures. Raising a floor is a one-line commit whose message says what the check examines; lowering one carries what changing a fixture expectation carries. Committed because it is a reference the run is measured against, never a result the run produces, which is why it lives here and not under artifacts/.
